{{Otheruses|Anoat}}
The '''Anoat trade corridor''' was a trade route connecting the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]] and [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]]. It had become defunct by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], presumably in lieu of the larger [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]]. The notorious [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Clabburn the Elder]] routinely stalked [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liners]] passing through the corridor en route to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the final decades before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
